text: At 82 minutes, Ironvale Athletic, trailing 3-2, raise their defensive line about 10 metres higher from their goal at the left end, pressing more aggressively towards the halfway line on the left flank and centre. Their two forwards push up to apply pressure around the midfield area on the right side, while midfielders move into more advanced positions closer to the opponent’s penalty area. This tactical shift sees Ironvale Athletic adopting a direct, vertical style to regain possession and create chances quickly, increasing their presence deep into Redmond Rovers’ half [#1477].
